name: Checkbox
description: Native pure-CSS checkbox: a self-drawing (reversible) check mark, indeterminate state, sizes, invalid; also provides the shared .mv-choice and .mv-choice-card layouts (option cards highlighted via :has(:checked)).
useWhen: Users pick any number of options from a list, or give a single opt-in such as accepting terms
A select-all control needs an indeterminate state above a nested list of options
Options need richer presentation as clickable cards with a title, description and icon

avoidWhen.when: The setting takes effect immediately, like turning a feature on or off
Only one option in the set may be chosen
The list of options is long and needs searching or filtering

classes.name: mv-checkbox
classes.description: On <input type="checkbox">. Set the indeterminate state in JS: input.indeterminate = true.

classes.name: mv-choice
classes.description: Shared (radio, switch): a <label> row with control + label, the control centered on the first line.

classes.name: mv-choice-card
classes.description: Shared: a clickable card <label> containing the input; highlighted when checked, ring on keyboard focus.

classes.name: mv-choice-icon
classes.description: Optional icon tile inside a card (tinted when checked).

attributes.name: data-control
attributes.description: On .mv-choice / .mv-choice-card: puts the control at the end of the row.

attributes.name: data-layout
attributes.description: On .mv-choice-group: auto-fit grid of cards (min width --mv-choice-min).

a11y: Native input: role, checked/mixed state (aria-checked=mixed for indeterminate), Space and form submission handled by the browser. The wrapping <label> provides the accessible name; link the description with aria-describedby. Focus ring visible for keyboard only; animations disabled with reduced motion.
